# Aadi Shah

> USC mechanical engineering senior working across venture investing, company building, and technology. Former Venture Analyst at ACME Capital, founder of Aside, and prior investor at Draper Associates and Bain Capital. Recruiting for full-time 2027 venture and growth-investing roles.

## About

Hi, I'm Aadi. I work across venture investing, company building, and engineering. Most recently, I was a Venture Analyst at ACME Capital, where I sourced early-stage companies for Silicon Foundry, evaluated hard tech, health, and consumer startups for ACME, and built an AI relationship-intelligence platform for both firms.

I'm also the founder of Aside, a premium dining app providing curated access to Singapore's high-end restaurants. I own the company end to end across product, app development, branding, venue outreach, onboarding, partnerships, and launch.

Previously, I was Draper Associates' sole Southern California scout, sourced and evaluated 30+ startups, and worked on a $100M+ private equity transaction at Bain Capital. I'm a Presidential Scholar and Viterbi Research Fellow at USC finishing a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering with a minor in Business Finance.

## What I'm looking for

Full-time roles starting in 2027, primarily in venture capital, growth investing, corporate venture, or adjacent technology-investment roles. Strongest fit: company sourcing, founder engagement, market and product diligence, investment writing, and commercial research across AI, deep tech, and emerging technology.

## Education

University of Southern California (USC). B.S. Mechanical Engineering, minor in Business Finance. May 2027. Major GPA: 3.6/4.0. Presidential Scholar, Viterbi Research Fellow, and Dean's List.

### Aside · Founder (Feb 2026 - Present)
Founded and built a premium dining app providing curated access to Singapore's high-end restaurants. Own product, app development, branding, venue outreach, onboarding, and partnerships; engaged 20 prospects pre-launch.

### ACME Capital · Venture Analyst (Mar 2026 - Aug 2026)

Evaluated 5+ hard tech, health, and consumer startups for ACME Capital through market and product research. Built an AI relationship-intelligence platform from scratch to map both firms' networks and surface relevant connections.

### Adaptive Security · GTM Intern (May 2026 - Jul 2026)
Owned RevOps at an AI security startup, managing Salesforce operations, lead routing, and workflow automation. Built Salesforce automations that improved record accuracy by approximately 30% and saved the team 1 to 2 hours daily.

### Draper Associates · Venture Scout (Dec 2023 - Dec 2025)
Sole Southern California scout. Sourced and evaluated 30+ startups across deep tech, aerospace, climate, drones, and AI. Met with founders, conducted product diligence and competitive mapping, and prepared investment summaries for review by the investment team.

### Ernst & Young (EY) · Intern - Technology Consulting (May 2025 - Aug 2025)
Only intern working directly with partners on a 45-person team supporting a S$10M Singapore government contract renewal. Supported tender repricing and scope negotiations, built budget models up to S$10M, and produced executive strategy decks for senior client and government leadership.

### Bain Capital · Summer Analyst - IndiaRF Private Equity (Jun 2024 - Aug 2024)
Sole undergraduate intern on a live $100M+ private equity transaction; the target company was subsequently acquired. Conducted commercial diligence on 5+ companies covering market sizing, competitive mapping, and key risk assessment. Prepared investment memos for senior leadership during deal evaluation.

### USC Rocket Propulsion Laboratory · Structural Analysis Engineer (Jan 2024 - May 2026)
Performed aerothermal and structural analysis of rocket nozzles and bulkheads in ANSYS for a 100+ member launch team.
